predecessors.name: Jin dynasty (Western and Eastern Jin)
predecessors.text: Lishi, where Liu Yuan 'declared himself Grand Chanyu' in 304 and then 'King of Han' (the Shanxi country of the Southern Xiongnu)

successors.name: Later Zhao
successors.text: the Han-Zhao realm: Chang'an and Shanggui, taken by Later Zhao forces in 329 when Liu Xi 'was driven from the capital and killed at Shanggui'

ledger.x: 304: Liu Yuan founds the Han at Lishi.
316: Chang'an falls and the Western Jin ends.
318: Liu Yao, acclaimed emperor after Jin Zhun's failed coup, moves the capital to Chang'an.
319: Liu Yao renames the state Zhao.
324: war between the two Zhao states.
328: Liu Yao takes Henan from Later Zhao, before the Battle of Luoyang.
329: the Former Zhao falls; Liang's submission passes to the victor.
329: Former Liang recovers the lands south of the Yellow River as the Former Zhao falls: 'Former Zhao falls to Later Zhao, and Former Liang recovers the lands south of the Yellow River.'
329: Liu Yao is captured at Luoyang on 21 January.

wars.name: Former Liang-Former Zhao war for the Yellow River lands
wars.outcome: Liu Yin took Former Liang land south of the Yellow River in 327; it returned to Former Liang in 329 when Former Zhao fell.

wars.name: Han-Zhao conquest of the Western Jin
wars.outcome: The Han take Pingyang (308), Luoyang and Emperor Huai (311, Disaster of Yongjia) and Chang'an and Emperor Min (316), ending the Western Jin.

wars.name: Zhao campaign against the Di, Qiang and Former Liang
wars.outcome: Liu Yao defeated the Di and Qiang rebels, moved nearly 200,000 people to Chang'an, and made Zhang Mao of Former Liang a vassal in 323.

wars.name: War between the Former and Later Zhao
wars.outcome: Liu Yao secured Henan in 328; at the Battle of Luoyang (328-329) he was captured on 21 January 329; Liu Xi was killed at Shanggui and the Former Zhao ended.

certainty.note: Commandery frontiers in Shanxi and Shaanxi; the Ordos and eastern Gansu edge and the Henan front are approximate; no page opened gives a treaty or survey line.
